select "r13"."c0" as "customer_id", cast("r13"."c1" as decimal(38, 10)) as "freight_ratio" from (select "r1"."c0" as "c0", cast((select cast(
    (case when sign(n) * sign(d) < 0 then '-' else '' end) ||
    cast(q // 10000000000 as varchar) || '.' || lpad(cast(q % 10000000000 as varchar), 10, '0')
    as decimal(38,10))
    from (select n, d, case when n is null or d is null then null else
      (abs(n) * 10000000000) // abs(d) +
      case when (abs(n) * 10000000000) % abs(d) >= abs(d) // 2 + abs(d) % 2 then 1 else 0 end end as q
      from (select cast(replace(cast(cast("r1"."c1" as decimal(38, 10)) as varchar), '.', '') as hugeint) as n,
        nullif(cast(replace(cast(cast("r1"."c2" as decimal(38, 10)) as varchar), '.', '') as hugeint), 0) as d) as golden_div_input
    ) as golden_div_rounded) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from (select "r2"."c0" as "c0", cast(sum(cast("r2"."c1" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", cast(sum(cast("r2"."c2" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c2" from (select "r3"."c0" as "c0", "r3"."c5" as "c1", "r3"."c4" as "c2" from (select "r4"."c0" as "c0", "r4"."c1" as "c1", "r4"."c2" as "c2", "r12"."c0" as "c3", "r12"."c1" as "c4", "r12"."c2" as "c5" from (select "customers"."customer_id" as "c0", "customers"."city" as "c1", "customers"."country" as "c2" from "customers") as "r4" left join (select "r6"."c2" as "c0", cast(coalesce("r6"."c7", cast($1 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", cast(coalesce("r6"."c5", cast($2 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c2" from (select "r7"."c0" as "c0", "r7"."c1" as "c1", "r7"."c2" as "c2", "r7"."c3" as "c3", "r7"."c4" as "c4", "r7"."c5" as "c5", "r11"."c0" as "c6", "r11"."c1" as "c7" from (select "orders"."order_id" as "c0", "orders"."order_date" as "c1", "orders"."customer_id" as "c2", "orders"."employee_id" as "c3", "orders"."shipped_date" as "c4", cast("orders"."freight" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c5" from "orders") as "r7" left join (select "r9"."c0" as "c0", cast(sum(cast(cast((cast(cast((cast("r9"."c1" as decimal(38, 10)) * cast("r9"."c2" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as decimal(38, 10)) * cast(cast((cast(cast($3 as integer) as decimal(38, 10)) - cast("r9"."c3" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from (select "order_details"."order_id" as "c0", cast("order_details"."unit_price" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", "order_details"."quantity" as "c2", cast("order_details"."discount" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c3" from "order_details") as "r9" group by "r9"."c0") as "r11" on ("r7"."c0" = "r11"."c0")) as "r6") as "r12" on ("r4"."c0" = "r12"."c0")) as "r3") as "r2" group by "r2"."c0") as "r1") as "r13" order by case when "r13"."c0" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r13"."c0" asc
